meta.scope: Mexico batch 8 (12 candidates) — additional government/justice censuses, financial system indicators, housing satellite / related, non-profit institutions, remaining high-value short-term and structural series. Core inventory largely covered; further growth would be incremental or state-specific.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional de Gobiernos Municipales y Demarcaciones Territoriales de la Ciudad de México (CNGMD)
candidates.description: Periodic census of municipal governments and Mexico City territorial demarcations covering structure, resources, public services, security, justice and other municipal functions. Primary structural source for municipal-level public administration statistics.
candidates.notes: Key municipal-jurisdiction product. Complements ENCIG (user perception) with supply-side institutional data on municipal governments. Part of the broader family of National Censuses of Government.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional de Impartición de Justicia Estatal (CNIJE) / National Census of State Justice Administration
candidates.description: Census of state-level justice institutions (courts, related bodies). Provides structural and workload statistics for the state justice system.
candidates.notes: Part of the SNIGSPIJ government/security/justice statistical subsystem. Complements ENVIPE perception and victimization data with institutional supply-side information.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional de Poderes Legislativos Estatales (CNPLE)
candidates.description: Census of state legislative powers covering structure, resources and legislative activity.
candidates.notes: Another component of the National Censuses of Government family; supplies institutional data on state legislatures.

candidates.title: Agregados monetarios y base monetaria / Monetary aggregates and monetary base
candidates.description: Regular statistics of the monetary base and broader monetary aggregates published by Banco de México. Used for monetary analysis and policy assessment.
candidates.notes: Core Banxico monetary statistics. Monetary base appears in the weekly balance-sheet communiqué; broader aggregates are published on a regular calendar and analysed in the quarterly reports.

candidates.title: Tasas de interés de mercado (Cetes, TIIE, etc.) / Market interest rates
candidates.description: Daily and periodic market interest-rate statistics (government securities yields, interbank rates, etc.) published or referenced by Banco de México. The policy rate (tasa objetivo) is the operational target; these series show transmission along the yield curve.
candidates.notes: Complements the policy-rate node. Banxico and market analysis routinely track pass-through from the overnight target to Cetes, TIIE and longer yields.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de crédito y vivienda Infonavit / Infonavit housing-credit statistics
candidates.publisher: Instituto del Fondo Nacional de la Vivienda para los Trabajadores (Infonavit)
candidates.description: Regular statistics on housing credits granted, outstanding portfolio and related housing-finance indicators from the main worker housing fund.
candidates.notes: Principal administrative source for formal housing finance linked to formal employment. Complements ENH / census housing data and appears in household balance-sheet and social-policy analysis.

candidates.title: Cuenta Satélite de las Instituciones sin Fines de Lucro / Satellite Account of Non-Profit Institutions
candidates.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of non-profit institutions serving households within the national-accounts framework.
candidates.notes: One of the standard suite of Mexican satellite accounts (with tourism, health, culture, unpaid work, environment). Completes the institutional coverage of the SCNM.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Defunciones Registradas (EDR) / Registered Death Statistics
candidates.description: Vital statistics of registered deaths compiled from civil-registration sources. Published with regular bulletins and used for mortality analysis and demographic estimation.
candidates.notes: Core civil-registration-based mortality series. Complements ENADID and census data for demographic analysis and is published on the regular INEGI calendar.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Nacimientos / Birth Statistics
candidates.description: Vital statistics of registered births. Companion series to death statistics within the vital-registration system.
candidates.notes: Completes the core vital-statistics pair with deaths. Used with ENADID and census data for fertility and population estimation.

candidates.title: Encuesta Mensual de Opinión Empresarial (EMOE) / Monthly Business Opinion Survey
candidates.description: Monthly qualitative survey of business expectations and assessments in manufacturing, construction and other sectors. Provides diffusion indices and confidence indicators.
candidates.notes: Soft short-term indicator that complements the hard quantitative surveys (EMIM, EMEC, EMS, ENEC). Used in cyclical analysis alongside Banxico and private-sector confidence measures.

candidates.title: IGAE por actividad económica / Global Indicator of Economic Activity by activity
candidates.description: Detailed activity breakdown of the monthly Global Indicator of Economic Activity (primary, secondary, tertiary and selected sub-activities).
candidates.notes: More granular view of the headline IGAE already listed. Useful as a distinct analytical product even though it is derived from the same underlying framework.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de finanzas públicas federales (SHCP) / Federal public-finance statistics
candidates.publisher: Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (SHCP)
candidates.description: Monthly and quarterly federal government revenue, expenditure, balance and debt statistics published by the Ministry of Finance. Complements the INEGI state/municipal public-finance series (EFIPEM).
candidates.notes: Primary federal fiscal series. Used with Banxico and INEGI data for overall public-sector analysis and is the natural counterpart to EFIPEM at the federal level.

proposed_edges.basis: CNGMD supplies institutional/municipal structure and service data; ENCIG supplies citizen perception and experience of the same services.
Non-profit satellite account is constructed within the SCNM / SNA 2008 framework.
Federal fiscal statistics (SHCP) and state/municipal fiscal statistics (INEGI EFIPEM) together cover the bulk of the public sector.
